name: zoto-agents
description: zotoio agent plugins: specs, evals, agent monitoring, and MCP testing.

plugins.name: zoto-spec-system
plugins.description: Decompose complex initiatives into reviewable specs, judge them independently, then execute with adversarial verification. Live execution status aggregation and no-restart token-budget configuration.

plugins.name: zoto-eval-system
plugins.description: Stamp static (pytest) and LLM (@cursor/sdk) eval suites side-by-side, detect drift when AI primitives change and update evals with user confirmation, compare runs across models on /canvas. Surgical update on git diff, sovereign user-authored cases.

plugins.name: zoto-cursor-top
plugins.description: Live updating htop-style CLI that shows every Cursor agent on this machine, with expandable parent-to-subagent hierarchy and scrolling log tails

plugins.name: botz-mcp-swarm
plugins.description: Capture, run, and diagnose MCP test suites with the botz MCP Swarm CLI. Skills install the botz host and its mcp-swarm extension on first use and run only when invoked by name.

plugins.name: botz-mcp-swarm-lite
plugins.description: Run MCP Swarm locally: skills for the bundled botz MCP Swarm CLI with no central Botz MCP server config. Introspect, test, load, diagnose and compare MCP servers on this machine.

plugins.name: crux-compress
plugins.description: Compress rules, code, images, and web pages into CRUX notation, with CRUX memories and meditation. Packages the CRUX-Compress release; run /z-crux-init once per project. Hooks need Python 3.

plugins.name: zoto-botz-skills
plugins.description: Consume governed Agent Skills and subagents from the hosted botz.ai MCP server (https://mcp.botz.ai/mcp, OAuth sign-in) with zero-drift guid+version pinning and CRUX-compressed downloads.
